name: playchessforme
description: Browser extension (Chrome + Firefox) that plays your chess.com live games while you're away. Violates chess.com's fair-play policy; use at your own risk.

scripts.build:chrome: npm run engine:copy && wxt build -b chrome
scripts.build:firefox: npm run engine:copy && wxt build -b firefox --mv3
scripts.zip: npm run engine:copy && wxt zip -b chrome && wxt zip -b firefox --mv3
